design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 1 (employer_instant_pay_disbursements, category disburse). Coordinator brief read in full; band: phone 6465550176, EIN last4 3926, persona surname Kowalski (K), employer Larkspur Table Group LLC (L), employee numbers 3201-3207.

[0 Draw] draw_counts.py --task 1 printed {"task": 1, "prerequisite_problems": 3, "problems": 4, "factor_counts": [5, 6, 4, 4]}. Assignment: disburse_ext_alert_election 6, disburse_ext_replenish_debit 5, disburse_ext_platform_fee 4, disburse_ext_funding_deposit (root) 4.

[0 Scope snapshot] Occupied by task 0: closing a service (early closure fee, closing-month platform fee). Claimed here: the platform fee of a completed billing month on the fee debit day, the employer's alert-level election for automatic replenishment (the replenishment floor), the automatic replenishment debit, and the employer's own funding deposit by ACH credit. Nothing is left over: the difficulty's six extended policies are split 2/4 and pairwise disjoint; task 1 never closes a service and never bills a closing month, task 0 never funds one.

[0 Design thesis] Surface goal: the payroll administrator wants to send an ACH credit today to get the Instant Pay account properly covered and asks for the exact amount. Core value: the funding deposit (966.06). Hidden chain: the deposit is worked out only once the alert level on file stands at the replenishment floor (the employer's own election, 2050.00) and only once every replenishment debit due against that alert is on the ledger (1700.00, which itself is sized only after the platform fee of March, due today on the fee debit day, is booked, 6.77). Depth 3 (fee -> debit -> deposit; election -> debit -> deposit), breadth 19 factors over the service ledger (payouts by destination and kind, deposits, the returned duplicate credit), the tier, the calendar (fee debit day, Friday) and the employer's Earned Wage Access Program Agreement (program difficulty). Two customer's own writes: the alert election (owner_ruling (a): the alert level decides when Paystride debits the employer's account, a change to the terms of its debit authorization) and the funding credit (owner_ruling (b): a payment the employer sends from its own bank account, stated as the employer's act in the rule).

[0 Why a good test] An agent that only reads the deposit rule computes alert 250.00 - balance 190.19 = 59.81 -> minimum deposit 100.00 or, with the cover factor, misses the floor entirely; one that finds the floor but not the debit quotes 2666.06; one that books the debit before the fee quotes 1059.29 (debit 1600.00); one that reads only computation documents gets 29.00 / 250.00 / 1900.00 / 166.58. Each figure needs ledger reconciliation (balance recomputed from the ledger, month windows of payouts by destination and kind), tier parameters, calendar facts and the other product's agreement.

[1 Policies] disburse_ext_platform_fee (state_due, subject disburse_fee, agent tool debit_platform_fee_9215b300 books the month before the current one); refs disburse_evt_fees, disburse_ewa_bundle; overwrites the fee-day clause (completed months only, tail sends the closing month to the closing-month rule - sibling of task 0's overwrite, C3) and the full-month bundle clause (three-tier bundle, sibling tail). disburse_ext_alert_election (on_request, subject disburse_settings_update, owner=user confirm_alert_level_1c610295); ref disburse_lifecycle; overwrite of 'The employer may change its funding method, auto replenishment or alert level at any time while the service is not closed; auto replenishment can be turned on only on tiers with auto_replenish_allowed.' restated with the floor condition. disburse_ext_replenish_debit (state_due, subject disburse_prefund_deposit, agent book_replenishment_debit_b3fe8e59); ref disburse_evt_prefund; overwrite of the base replenishment trigger sentence (restated with 'of at least auto_replenish_minimum_usd', the sizing and the floor wait). disburse_ext_funding_deposit (on_request, subject disburse_prefund_deposit, owner=user send_prefund_ach_credit_62da4f1e); ref disburse_evt_prefund; overwrite [] - base 'The employer prefunds the service by ACH credit, wire, or an ACH debit it authorized.' and 'A deposit is at least minimum_deposit_usd' are kept; an ACH credit carries no deposit fee, so nothing falls due after the root (a wire would owe wire_deposit_fee_usd 15.00 at Core).

[1 Factor cards] Platform fee (29.00 list, Core): pf_activation (parameter) activated 2026-03-16 in the billing month after day 10 -> 2/3 (baseline 1 -> 10.15); pf_bundle (method, program) agreement live since 2025-06-02 -> 50 in full (tier b would scale by the part of the month after go-live; baseline 0 -> 16.43); pf_size (parameter, program) Paystride Program Professional -> 5 (baseline -> 7.73); pf_fee_model (parameter, program) employer_paid -> 10 (baseline -> 8.70); 29.00 x 2/3 x 0.35 = 6.77; whole baseline 29.00. Replenishment floor: af_volume (method) 20 payouts after 2026-03-03 totalling 4868.45 -> max(250, 4868.45/4) = 1217.11 (baseline 250 -> 450.00); af_instant 15/20 instant -> 20 (-> 1800.00); af_age 0 whole months -> 10 (-> 1900.00); af_returns one returned deposit in 12 months -> 15 (-> 1850.00); af_final_pay one final pay in 3 months -> 5 (-> 1950.00); af_groups (program) 3 payroll groups -> 15 (-> 1850.00); 1217.11 x 1.65 = 2008.24 -> up to 2050.00; whole baseline 250.00. Replenishment debit (round 2 design; baseline = the alert level on file less the ledger balance, never below the minimum): rd_size (method, multi-source over the ledger balance and the month's payout total) - ledger balance 183.42 below half of 2050 AND the month's payouts 4868.45 above twice the alert (4100.00) -> restores 2050 + 4868.45/4 - 183.42 = 3083.69 (baseline 1866.58 -> 1000.00; skipping the volume test gives the first tier 2366.58 -> 1300.00); rd_weekend Friday -> 20 (-> 1400.00); rd_ewa (program) live agreement remitting by ach_debit_authorization -> 10 (-> 1500.00); rd_new_service -> x0.8 (-> 2100.00); rd_returns return on 2026-03-26 inside 3 whole months -> x0.5 (-> 3300.00); 3083.69 x 1.3 x 0.8 x 0.5 = 1603.52 -> up to 1700.00; whole baseline 1900.00. Funding deposit: fd_cover (method) 4868.45/30 x 2 = 324.56 (baseline nothing -> 576.58); fd_headcount (program) 310 -> 5 (-> 847.33); fd_tips 18/20 = 90 percent tips -> 10 (-> 728.60); fd_off_cycle one off-cycle payout -> 5 (-> 847.33); (2050 + 324.56) x 1.2 - 1883.42 = 966.06; whole baseline 2050 - 1883.42 = 166.58. Near-misses: the five bank-account payouts are not instant; the 2026-03-24 off-cycle and 2026-03-30 final pay payouts are not tips; the returned duplicate credit is a deposit return, not a payout; a payout dated 2026-03-03 would fall outside the month window (probe). No stamp field names a tier.

[1 Prerequisite card] Four edges, all value_input, all state form. (1) deposit -> election, gate alert_on_file: 'Before a funding deposit is worked out, the alert level on file must stand at the replenishment floor.' (affirmative 'before ... must'); (2) deposit -> debit, gate ledger_balance: 'A funding deposit is not quoted until the ledger carries the automatic replenishment debit that the balance's fall below the alert level on file makes due.' (negated 'not ... until', the way a desk states a quote it holds back); (3) debit -> election, gate alert_on_file: 'A replenishment debit is not pulled until the alert level on file stands at or above the replenishment floor.' (negated; a release waits); (4) debit -> fee, gate ledger_balance: 'A replenishment debit is sized only after the ledger carries the platform fee of every completed billing month whose fee debit day has come.' (affirmative 'only after'). Four-point test passed for each (ordering connective; record-visible state - an alert level on the service record, a kind of entry on the ledger; no tool, id or code token; exact scope). Exactly one write brings each state about: the alert level only through the employer's election tool (the desk has no settings tool), the replenishment debit only through the replenishment booking, the completed-month platform fee only through the platform-fee booking (the closing-month fee of task 0 bills the month of a closure, not a completed month). Derivations: the deposit rule + service record (alert 250.00) + the election rule (floor 2050.00) -> hand the election to the employer; the debit rule + ledger (balance 190.19 below the alert since 2026-04-02, no auto_replenish deposit) -> book the debit after the election; the debit's fee sentence + ledger (no platform fee) + frozen_time (third business day of April) -> book March's fee first. Unresolved at frozen_time: disburse_services.<svc>.low_balance_alert_usd = 250.0; prefund_balance = 190.19 with auto_replenish true and no auto_replenish deposit; the only fee entry is the prefund_return fee. Load (verify.py SKIP runs): skip fee -> debit 1600.00, deposit 1059.29; skip election -> the alert stays below the floor, no debit may be pulled and the deposit is 506.06; skip debit -> deposit 2666.06. Topological order: fee, election, debit, deposit; fee and election commute (swap run: identical values and terminal DB). user_scenario names no prerequisite; tools validate nothing.

[1 Base-invariant card] Platform fee (subject disburse_fee): disburse_evt_fees.one_fee 'A source entry incurs at most one fee of each fee type, and the platform fee is debited once per billing month.' - no monthly_platform entry exists at all (the only fee is the prefund_return fee, whose billing_month is empty), so 2026-03 is debited once; correlation bound to empty source values (a platform fee points to no entry). disburse_ewa_bundle: no gate (policy_scope). Election (subject disburse_settings_update): disburse_lifecycle has no gate for settings; the service is active, not closed. Debit and deposit (subject disburse_prefund_deposit): disburse_evt_prefund's only gate concerns deposit returns (policy_scope); Core allows auto replenishment (auto_replenish_allowed true); both deposits stay above minimum_deposit_usd 100 and far below max_prefund_balance_usd 75000. No time eligibility gate applies (temporal_feasibility []). Fee debit day: 2026-04-01 Wed, 04-02 Thu, 04-03 Fri -> 2026-04-03 is the third business day (no Federal Reserve holiday), the day March's fee falls due.

[1 Business-object card] Object: the employer's only disbursement service 39f2487b-... Ledger balance = deposits 3000.00 + 2093.64 + 2093.64 less the returned duplicate 2093.64, payouts 4868.45 and the 35.00 return fee = 190.19 (the cached prefund_balance agrees). Month window (dates after 2026-03-03): all 20 payouts; instant = external_debit_card (15); tips (18); off-cycle (1, 2026-03-24); final pay (1, 2026-03-30, also inside the 3-month window). Returned deposits: one (2026-03-26), inside both the 3- and 12-month windows. Agreement read with status live: Paystride Program Professional, employer_paid, 3 payroll groups, headcount 310, remittance ach_debit_authorization, go-live 2025-06-02.

[3 Seed] Employer Larkspur Table Group LLC (phone 6465550176, EIN 3926, ZIP 43215). Service Paystride Instant Pay Core, enrolled 2026-03-09, activated 2026-03-16 after the 2026-03-11 deposit became available (2 business days), funding employer_ach_credit, auto_replenish true (authorized as a backstop), alert 250.00 = Core low_balance_alert_default_usd. The balance stayed at or above 250.00 until the 2026-04-02 payouts took it to 190.19, so no replenishment debit was ever due before; since then one is due but may not be pulled while the alert on file is below the floor - the world the rule produces. The 2026-03-23 duplicate credit (daily_sequence 2) was returned on 2026-03-26 by the employer's bank with the 35.00 Core return fee pointing to the return; one return in 90 days does not suspend the service. All 20 payouts are within the 100 included disbursements (no per-disbursement fee), instant ones delivered within the 30-minute SLA (no late-delivery credit), none to a Paystride card (no card load trigger), all within Core limits and funded from available money. No platform fee existed before: March is the activation month. Volume review: only one complete month since activation -> no tier move owed. Agreement row: Program Professional for 310 eligible employees (band 250-999), signed 2025-04-21, term 24, renewal 2027-04-21 = signed + term, live since 2025-06-02, receivables 0.00 (nothing owed on that product). Payee profiles not seeded (no decision reads them; the replay closure excludes them).

[4 Persona] Renata Kowalski (K), payroll administrator, practical and pressed for time before the weekend tip-outs. Volunteers the goal (send an ACH credit today, exact amount) and the reason (balance runs thin before weekends). Verification: phone and email, ZIP/EIN as a third detail. Other programs and the March duplicate payment only if asked. Passive: agrees to confirm the new alert level and runs it herself with the agent's figure; accepts the fee and the automatic top-up; sends the credit herself with the exact amount; asks for the amount if not given; ends when the credit is booked. Nothing names the floor, the debit, the fee or any order.

[5 Verification] verify.py output (real tools): step 0 platform fee expected 6.77 (pf_activation 10.15, pf_bundle 16.43, pf_size 7.73, pf_fee_model 8.7, ALL-BASELINE 29.0); step 1 election expected 2050.0 (af_volume 450.0, af_instant 1800.0, af_age 1900.0, af_returns 1850.0, af_final_pay 1950.0, af_groups 1850.0, ALL-BASELINE 250.0); step 2 debit expected 1700.0 (rd_size 1000.0, rd_weekend 1400.0, rd_ewa 1500.0, rd_new_service 2100.0, rd_returns 3300.0, ALL-BASELINE 1900.0); step 3 deposit expected 966.06 (fd_cover 576.58, fd_headcount 847.33, fd_tips 728.60, fd_off_cycle 847.33, ALL-BASELINE 166.58). SKIP fee -> debit 1600.0, deposit 1059.29; SKIP election -> under the rule no debit may be pulled and the deposit recomputes to 506.06 (verify.py's ungated replay books 500.0 and gives 100.0, a world the rule never produces); SKIP debit -> deposit 2666.06. Swap run (election before fee): identical values and terminal DB. The duplicate-credit amount (round 2: 2093.64) was chosen by a scan so that every factor and every edge moves its result across the 50/100 rounding steps and no figure sits within 1e-6 of a half cent. Gates (--task 1): EXTENDED OK, TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK, REPLAY OK (closure 28 = init 28), SOLVABILITY OK, COMPUTE OK, GROUNDING OK, SCOPE OK; traceability (pre-docs) misses only the four unlock tool names. Revisions: (r1) factors that read only a holding field or a tier parameter (funding method, ACH availability) fail the record-evidence rule -> replaced by record-read factors (returns, final pay, payroll groups, headcount, off-cycle); (r2) the debit waits on a state that must be unmet at the opening -> the seed now leaves the balance below the alert level since the 2026-04-02 payouts with no debit pulled; (r3) skipping the fee first left the rounded debit unchanged -> deposit amounts rescanned; (r4) the base minimum kept in the replenishment overwrite text (C4).

[XF recipe sweep] A1 factor-reads (transitive): pf_activation <- activated_date, billing_month_index(plain); pf_bundle <- CFIELD go_live_date, billing_month_index; pf_size <- CFIELD variant_name; pf_fee_model <- CFIELD fee_model; af_volume <- SUM/MAX payouts, payouts_month_count(plain); af_instant <- COUNT instant, payouts_month_count; af_age <- MONTHS activation; af_returns <- COUNT returns; af_final_pay <- COUNT final pay; af_groups <- CFIELD payroll_group_count; rd_size <- ledger_balance(plain), the month's payout SUM, alert_on_file(plain); rd_weekend <- DAYS weekday; rd_ewa <- EXISTS live, CFIELD remittance_method; rd_new_service <- MONTHS; rd_returns <- COUNT returns (3 and 12 months); fd_cover <- SUM/MAX payouts, payouts_month_count; fd_headcount <- CFIELD eligible_headcount; fd_tips <- COUNT tips; fd_off_cycle <- COUNT off-cycle. No factor reads another factor's binding. A2/A3: assembly sentences generic and ordered (percentages summed then multipliers then rounding up; the floor's percentages summed then rounding up; the deposit's amounts added, percentages summed, balance subtracted, rounding once). A4 defining-sentence table: payouts_month_count (volume/cover sentences) shared by af_volume/af_instant and fd_cover/fd_tips/fd_off_cycle -> plain in each policy; alert_on_file and the ledger balance are defined in the base and size sentences and read by the baseline as well as by rd_size -> plain bindings in each policy (round 4). A6 all-pairs method tiers: pf_bundle full rate vs rate x go-live part (adds the go-live-day input) vs nothing (not zero across the other tiers' domains); af_volume max(default, total/4) vs max(default, largest payout) vs default; rd_size alert+minimum-balance vs alert+month total/4-balance vs alert-balance; fd_cover total/30 x availability days vs largest payout vs nothing - every pair differs by an input. A7: af_volume's greater-of is owned by the factor (T1: baseline 450 differs; T2: alone it moves 250 to 1217.11); the debit's minimum floor and the deposit's minimum never bind on this world; T2 for the debit's multipliers (audit F-4): with every other factor at its baseline the debit restores the alert level less the balance (1866.58 here), so rd_new_service alone gives 1500.00 and rd_returns alone 1000.00 against 1900.00 - each moves the result on its own; the 50/100 round-ups are crossed by every substitution (scan). A8: no factor id is a substring of a tool name. B1/B2 probes (probe_t1.py): terminated Strategic agreement listed first -> ignored by every read (status filter); no agreement -> bundle/size/fee model 0 (fee 19.33), groups None -> 0 (floor 1850), agreement percentage 0, headcount 0; go-live 2026-03-12 -> bundle one third (13.21); go-live on 2026-03-01 -> full; a payout dated 2026-03-03 -> outside the month window, inside the 3-month final-pay window; a payout return of 900.00 -> not a payout (no change); clock on Saturday -> weekend 10, Monday -> 0; a return dated 2025-11-20 -> multiplier 0.75. B4: RND(x+1e-9, 2) in compute, Decimal half-up in tools; the round-ups compute the ceiling of (amount - 1e-9) to the multiple, so an exact multiple is kept, as the rule now says in words; figures 6.7667, 2008.24, 1603.52, 966.056, 576.58, 847.3276, 728.5997, 1059.29 are all away from a half cent. B5: sweep.py - every compute_basis quote, baseline sentence, replaced_by and prerequisite sentence is verbatim in its rule. Events written with base triggers: disburse_fee [], disburse_settings_update [], disburse_prefund_deposit [] (twice); no payout written. E2: the agreement fields read (status, go_live_date, variant_name, fee_model, payroll_group_count, eligible_headcount, remittance_method) cannot be moved by anything owed at once on the program product at 2026-04-03.

[6 Standard solution] find_customers(name) -> verify (phone, email) -> find_disburse_services -> find_disburse_ledger -> find_program_agreements -> book March's platform fee 6.77 (monthly_platform, '') -> hand over the alert election 2050.00 (employer runs it) -> book the replenishment debit 1700.00 -> hand over the ACH credit 966.06 (employer sends it). Terminal: fee 6.77, alert 2050.00, debit 1700.00 (auto_replenish), credit 966.06 (employer_initiated), balance 2849.48.

[Draft recomputation from the visible context] From the rules as they will be published, the schemas, the persona and the finder returns: the deposit rule names two waits; the service record shows the alert at 250.00 and the election rule gives a floor of 2050.00 from the month's payouts, the returned credit, the final pay, the service's age and the agreement's payroll groups; the debit rule waits on that alert and on March's fee (today is the fee debit day, no fee on the ledger); the fee rule gives 6.77; the debit rule gives 1700.00 from the recomputed ledger balance and the month's payout total; the deposit rule gives 966.06. Same order and figures as gold; no second reading found.


[REWORK round 2] Audit items closed (audits/policy_task/employer_instant_pay_disbursements, revision_1): F-3 - the completed-month platform fee rule declares a scoped overwrite of 'Fees are debited from the prefund balance under the tier held on the day they are incurred.': the completed-month platform fee is billed under the tier held on its fee debit day, and every other fee, the closing-month platform fee included, keeps the base sentence. F-4 - the replenishment baseline is now 'the alert level on file less the ledger balance, never below auto_replenish_minimum_usd', so with every other factor at baseline the two multipliers act on a gap that can exceed the minimum and each moves the debit alone (T2); rd_size keeps three distinct methods (alert plus minimum, alert plus a week of the month's payouts, alert) and its fall-through equals the baseline. T1-F1 - rd_size is multi-source: both non-fall-through tiers combine the ledger balance against half the alert level with the month's payout total against volume_alert_multiple times the alert level (two different aggregates over different entry families). T1-C1 - the skip-election proof now states the rule's world: with the alert at 250.00 below the floor no debit may be pulled and the deposit is 506.06; the ungated formula value is named as such. F-6 - every multi-month window and whole-month count in the alert, debit and deposit rules states its convention (entries dated fewer than N whole months before today; whole months = calendar-month difference less one when the later day-number is smaller). O-T1-2 - the deposit's prerequisite sentence names the single debit the balance's fall makes due. O-T1-1 - the persona no longer says 'before anything else'. O-7 - the completed-month bundle tail repeats the half-up rounding. World re-scan: the duplicate credit is 2093.64 so the platform fee still moves the rounded debit (1600.00 -> 1700.00) and every factor and edge still bears weight; new figures: fee 6.77, floor 2050.00, debit 1700.00, deposit 966.06 (skip fee 1600.00/1059.29, skip debit 2666.06). Realism note (audit O-6): rd_ewa is kept as an underwriting input - Paystride already debits this employer's account every payday for EWA remittances, a proven debit relationship that supports a larger pull.

[REWORK round 4] Renderer source findings (audits/render_source/employer_instant_pay_disbursements/render_r1.md). F1 (round-up at exact multiples): the two next-multiple expressions (replenishment floor and replenishment debit) are now written -((-(amount) + 0.000000001) // k) * k, i.e. the ceiling of (amount - 1e-9) to the multiple - the same values the earlier form produced (recomputed: floor 250.00 stays 250.00, 550.00 stays 550.00, 249.99 -> 250.00, 250.0000001 -> 300.00) - and the three rule sentences now say 'rounded up to the nearest multiple ... that is not below it, an amount that already is such a multiple being kept', so rule words equal compute at exact multiples. Every scored, baseline and sensitivity figure was recomputed on the handling-time worlds and checked against its rounding step: all pre-rounding amounts sit at least 2.62 from a multiple of 50/100 and every cent-rounded figure at least 0.0005 from a half cent, except the replenishment floor's whole baseline, which is the tier default 250 exactly (integer default times one, computed without float noise) and is kept by the rule's own words. No figure changed. F2 (shared record selection inside a factor): ledger_balance is removed from rd_size's bindings and is a plain binding claimed by the computation document (the baseline sentence defines it; the platform-fee edge's gate stays ledger_balance); rd_size keeps the month's payout total and its ladder, and stays multi-source over the two bindings.
user_scenario:
You are Renata Kowalski, the payroll administrator of Larkspur Table Group LLC, which runs three restaurants in Columbus, Ohio. It is Friday morning, a few hours before the weekend tip-outs start, and you are calling Paystride's employer desk from the back office with your laptop open. Your servers' tips go out through the company's Paystride Instant Pay service, and the balance keeps running thin before weekends. You want to put money in yourself today from Larkspur's operating account by ACH, enough to get the account properly covered, and you need the desk to tell you exactly how much to send. You open with that: you'd like to send an ACH credit today so the Instant Pay account is properly covered, and you need the exact amount.

When the agent asks who you are, you give the business name, Larkspur Table Group LLC, and say you are Renata Kowalski, the payroll administrator on the account. For verification you give the phone number on file, 6465550176, and your work email, rkowalski@larkspurtable.com; if one more detail is wanted you can give the billing ZIP code, 43215, or the last four digits of the company's EIN, 3926. You don't keep Paystride reference numbers and leave all lookups to the agent. Only if the agent asks whether Larkspur uses other Paystride programs do you say that your staff also have Paystride Earned Wage Access through the company; you don't know its settings. Only if the agent asks about earlier deposits do you mention that your bank pulled back a payment you had accidentally sent twice in March.

You don't know Paystride's levels or formulas and you never suggest a figure. If the agent explains that the account's low-balance alert level has to be confirmed at a new amount, you agree, and when the agent hands you that confirmation you run it yourself straight away with exactly the amount the agent gives you. If the agent tells you a monthly fee is being taken today or that an automatic top-up will be pulled from your bank under your existing authorization, you say that's fine. When the agent gives you the amount to send and hands you the ACH credit, you send it yourself with exactly that amount; if the agent asks you to send money without giving an amount, you ask how much first. Once the agent tells you the credit has been booked, you thank them and end the call.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Locate the employer profile of Larkspur Table Group LLC by the business name the caller states.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Every later read and write is keyed on the employer's customer reference; the caller knows only the business name.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Confirm the caller is the employer on file with two matching credentials (phone and email).
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Identity must be confirmed before any account detail is discussed or any money is moved.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the Instant Pay Disbursement service: tier Paystride Instant Pay Core, active, activated_date 2026-03-16, auto_replenish true, low_balance_alert_usd 250.00, prefund_balance 190.19.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The tier fixes the platform fee, auto_replenish_minimum_usd, low_balance_alert_default_usd, ach_deposit_availability_business_days and minimum_deposit_usd; the alert level on file below the replenishment floor is the state both the replenishment debit and the funding deposit wait on; the activation date drives the billed part, the age percentage and the new-service multiplier.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the whole service ledger: deposits (two of 2026-03-23, one of them returned on 2026-03-26 with its 35.00 return fee), the 20 payouts of 2026-03-17..2026-04-02 with their destinations and kinds, and no platform fee for 2026-03 and no replenishment debit.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Shows the missing 2026-03 platform fee and the missing replenishment debit (the states the debit and the deposit wait on), the ledger balance, the month's payout total, count, instant, tips, final pay and off-cycle counts, the largest payout and the returned deposit.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the employer's Earned Wage Access Program Agreement: live since 2025-06-02, Paystride Program Professional, employer_paid, 3 payroll groups, eligible_headcount 310, remittances by ach_debit_authorization.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Decides the bundle, program-size and fee-model percentages of the platform fee, the payroll-group percentage of the floor, the agreement percentage of the debit and the headcount percentage of the deposit.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the completed-month platform fee booking.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair; no DB effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Debit the 2026-03 platform fee (6.77 USD) on today's fee debit day, so the ledger carries the platform fee of every completed billing month whose fee debit day has come.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: disburse_ext_platform_fee computes the amount; the replenishment debit is sized only after this entry exists.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount: 6.77 = RND(29.00 x 2/3 (pf_activation: activated 2026-03-16) x (1 - (50 bundle [pf_bundle: live agreement, go-live 2025-06-02] + 5 size [pf_size: Professional] + 10 fee model [pf_fee_model: employer_paid]) / 100) + 1e-9, 2), on the opening world (first write). The computation document alone gives 29.00.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.disburse_service_id: 39f2487b-c129-4e24-b567-5b5d4c6e09d5; basis: the docstring 'the reference number of the employer's Instant Pay Disbursement service' and the find_disburse_services return for the verified employer; uniqueness: the employer holds exactly one disbursement service ('An employer may not hold a second disbursement service that is not closed.').
argument_uniqueness_tracing.fee_type: monthly_platform; basis: the docstring 'monthly_platform — the platform fee of a completed billing month, the only kind of fee this tool books' and the rule 'booked as one platform fee entry for that billing month'; uniqueness: the only value the tool books.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.related_entry_id: '' (empty); basis: the docstring 'a platform fee arises from no ledger entry, so it is passed as an empty string' and the rule '...that points to no source entry'; uniqueness: any other value books nothing.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the employer's own alert-level confirmation so it can be handed to the payroll administrator.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair for the customer's own write; no DB effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: The payroll administrator confirms the replenishment floor, 2050.00 USD, as the alert level on file.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: disburse_ext_alert_election computes low_balance_alert_usd; the alert level of an auto-replenishing service is the employer's own election.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.low_balance_alert_usd: 2050.00 = the replenishment floor: base 1217.11 (af_volume: 4868.45 / 4) raised by 20 (af_instant) + 10 (af_age) + 15 (af_returns) + 5 (af_final_pay) + 15 (af_groups) = 65 percent to 2008.24, rounded up to the nearest multiple of 50 not below it. The floor does not read the balance, so step 6 does not change it; the computation document alone gives 250.00.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.disburse_service_id: 39f2487b-c129-4e24-b567-5b5d4c6e09d5; basis: the docstring 'the reference number of the employer's Instant Pay Disbursement service' and the find_disburse_services return for the verified employer; uniqueness: the employer holds exactly one disbursement service ('An employer may not hold a second disbursement service that is not closed.').

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the automatic replenishment debit booking.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair; no DB effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Pull the automatic replenishment debit of 1700.00 USD now due against the 2050.00 alert level.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: disburse_ext_replenish_debit computes the amount; the funding deposit is not quoted until this debit is on the ledger.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount: 1700.00, evaluated after steps 6 and 8: the debit restores 3083.69 (rd_size: balance 183.42 below half of 2050.00 and the month's payouts 4868.45 above twice the alert, so the alert level plus 4868.45 / 4, less the balance) x 1.30 (rd_weekend 20 + rd_ewa 10) x 0.8 (rd_new_service) x 0.5 (rd_returns) = 1603.52 -> nearest multiple of 100 not below it = 1700.00. Without step 6 the same reading gives 1600.00; without step 8 the alert stays at 250.00, below the floor, and no debit may be pulled at all; the computation document alone (alert level less the balance) gives 1900.00.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.disburse_service_id: 39f2487b-c129-4e24-b567-5b5d4c6e09d5; basis: the docstring 'the reference number of the employer's Instant Pay Disbursement service' and the find_disburse_services return for the verified employer; uniqueness: the employer holds exactly one disbursement service ('An employer may not hold a second disbursement service that is not closed.').

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the employer's own ACH credit so it can be handed to the payroll administrator.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair for the customer's own write; no DB effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: The payroll administrator sends the 966.06 USD funding deposit by the employer's own ACH credit.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: disburse_ext_funding_deposit computes the amount; sending it is the employer's own payment.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount: 966.06, evaluated after steps 6, 8 and 10: funding level (2050.00 + cover 324.56 [fd_cover]) x 1.20 (fd_headcount 5 + fd_tips 10 + fd_off_cycle 5) = 2849.48, less the ledger balance 1883.42 = 966.056 -> 966.06 (above minimum_deposit_usd 100). Without step 10 it would be 2666.06; without step 6 the debit is 1600.00 and the deposit 1059.29; without step 8 the alert stays 250.00, no debit may be pulled and the deposit is (250.00 + 324.56) x 1.20 - 183.42 = 506.06; the computation document alone gives 166.58.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.disburse_service_id: 39f2487b-c129-4e24-b567-5b5d4c6e09d5; basis: the docstring 'the reference number of the employer's Instant Pay Disbursement service' and the find_disburse_services return for the verified employer; uniqueness: the employer holds exactly one disbursement service ('An employer may not hold a second disbursement service that is not closed.').

factor_trace: af_volume (method): 20 payouts dated after 2026-03-03 (the month ending today), total 4868.45 -> base = greater of low_balance_alert_default_usd 250.00 and 4868.45 / weeks_per_month 4 = 1217.11; baseline 250.00 gives 450.00.

af_instant (parameter): 15 of the 20 payouts in that month went to external debit cards (more than half) -> instant_heavy_percent 20; near-miss: the 5 bank-account payouts do not count; baseline 0 gives 1800.00.
af_age (parameter): MONTHS(2026-03-16, 2026-04-03) = 0 < age_new_months 2 -> age_new_percent 10; baseline 0 gives 1900.00.

af_returns (parameter): one disburse_prefund_return in the 12 months ending today (disburse_ledger.6401d352-95b5-49bd-87f9-3b94d84138b5, 2026-03-26, the reversed duplicate credit) -> returns_one_percent 15; baseline 0 gives 1850.00.
af_final_pay (parameter): one final_pay payout (2026-03-30, 640.00) in the 3 months ending today -> final_pay_one_percent 5; baseline 0 gives 1950.00.
af_groups (parameter, cross-difficulty program): live agreement payroll_group_count 3 >= groups_many 3 -> groups_many_percent 15; baseline 0 gives 1850.00.
plain: result = 1217.1125 x (1 + (20 + 10 + 15 + 5 + 15)/100) = 2008.24, rounded up to the nearest multiple of floor_rounding_usd 50 not below it = 2050.00.

more than half of the month's payouts went to external debit cards

factor_trace: rd_size (method, multi-source: the ledger balance AND the month's payout total): ledger balance at handling time 183.42 (7187.28 deposits - 2093.64 returned deposit - 4868.45 payouts - 35.00 return fee - 6.77 platform fee booked at step 6) is below half of the alert level 2050.00 set at step 8, and the 20 payouts dated fewer than one whole month before today total 4868.45, more than volume_alert_multiple 2 x 2050.00 = 4100.00 -> the debit restores 2050.00 + 4868.45 / weeks_per_month 4 - 183.42 = 3083.69; a reader who skips the volume test lands in the first tier (2050.00 + 500.00 - 183.42 = 2366.58 -> 1300.00); baseline (alert level less the balance) 1866.58 gives 1000.00.
rd_weekend (parameter): DAYS('2000-01-07', 2026-04-03) % 7 = 0, a Friday -> weekend_friday_percent 20; baseline 0 gives 1400.00.
rd_ewa (parameter, cross-difficulty program): agreement bc4d6ee9-bba4-4b57-b22f-df6bca6ca7ad is live and remits by ach_debit_authorization -> ewa_debit_percent 10; baseline 0 gives 1500.00.
rd_new_service (parameter): 0 whole months since activation < new_service_months 2 -> new_service_multiplier 0.8; baseline 1 gives 2100.00.

rd_returns (parameter): a returned deposit (disburse_ledger.6401d352-95b5-49bd-87f9-3b94d84138b5, 2026-03-26) dated fewer than risk_window_months 3 whole months before today -> recent_return_multiplier 0.5; baseline 1 gives 3300.00.
plain: 3083.69 x (1 + (20 + 10)/100) x 0.8 x 0.5 = 1603.52, rounded up to the nearest multiple of debit_rounding_usd 100 not below it = 1700.00, not below 500.00.

factor_sensitivity.tier_taken: the ledger balance is below half the alert level and the month's payouts came to more than volume_alert_multiple times the alert level
the debit is pulled on a Friday

factor_trace: fd_cover (method): payouts were sent in the month ending today (4868.45) -> cover = 4868.45 / days_per_month 30 x ach_deposit_availability_business_days 2 (Core) = 324.56; baseline nothing gives 576.58.

fd_headcount (parameter, cross-difficulty program): agreement bc4d6ee9-bba4-4b57-b22f-df6bca6ca7ad eligible_headcount 310 >= headcount_mid 100 (below headcount_large 500) -> headcount_mid_percent 5; baseline 0 gives 847.33.

edges.condition: disburse_services.low_balance_alert_usd of the service is at the replenishment floor worked out for it
edges.policy_source: Before a funding deposit is worked out, the alert level on file must stand at the replenishment floor.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: At 2026-04-03 the alert level on file is 250.00, the Core enrollment default, while the replenishment floor worked out from the service's records is 2050.00.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Step 8 records 2050.00 as low_balance_alert_usd; the funding level the deposit restores is built on it.

edges.condition: disburse_ledger holds the disburse_prefund_deposit with deposit_source auto_replenish that the balance's fall below the alert level on file makes due
edges.policy_source: A funding deposit is not quoted until the ledger carries the automatic replenishment debit that the balance's fall below the alert level on file makes due.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: Automatic replenishment is on and the ledger balance has been 190.19, below the 250.00 alert level on file, since the 2026-04-02 payouts, yet the ledger holds no deposit with deposit_source auto_replenish; the debit due is missing.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Step 10 books the 1700.00 replenishment debit (deposit_source auto_replenish); the ledger balance the deposit is measured against rises from 183.42 to 1883.42.

edges.condition: disburse_services.low_balance_alert_usd of the service is at or above the replenishment floor worked out for it
edges.policy_source: A replenishment debit is not pulled until the alert level on file stands at or above the replenishment floor.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The alert level on file, 250.00, is below the 2050.00 replenishment floor, so no replenishment debit may be pulled.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Step 8 raises the alert level to 2050.00; the debit restores the balance to that level.

edges.condition: disburse_ledger holds a disburse_fee entry with fee_type monthly_platform for the completed billing month whose fee debit day has come
edges.policy_source: A replenishment debit is sized only after the ledger carries the platform fee of every completed billing month whose fee debit day has come.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: Today, 2026-04-03, is the third business day of April, the fee debit day for billing month 2026-03, and the ledger holds no platform fee entry at all; its only fee is the prefund_return fee of the reversed duplicate credit.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Step 6 books the 6.77 platform fee for 2026-03; the ledger balance the debit is sized from falls from 190.19 to 183.42.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The platform fee and the alert-level election are parallel prerequisites (of the replenishment debit, and the election also of the deposit). They commute: the platform fee changes only the ledger and the cached balance, the election changes only low_balance_alert_usd, and the replenishment floor does not read the balance. verify.py run with the election first (plan_t1_swap.json) gives the same four values (6.77, 2050.00, 1700.00, 966.06) and an identical terminal DB. Every other pair is ordered by a prerequisite sentence: the debit waits on both ('A replenishment debit is not pulled until the alert level on file stands at or above the replenishment floor.', 'A replenishment debit is sized only after the ledger carries the platform fee of every completed billing month whose fee debit day has come.') and the deposit waits on the election and the debit ('Before a funding deposit is worked out, the alert level on file must stand at the replenishment floor.', 'A funding deposit is not quoted until the ledger carries the automatic replenishment debit that the balance's fall below the alert level on file makes due.').

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping step 8 leaves the alert at 250.00, below the 2050.00 floor: under the replenishment rule no debit may be pulled, and the funding level falls to (250.00 + 324.56) x 1.20, so the deposit becomes 506.06 instead of 966.06. (Evaluated ungated, the debit formula would give 500.00, a value the rule never books.)
Skipping step 10 leaves the balance at 183.42: the funding deposit becomes 2666.06 instead of 966.06, and the 1700.00 replenishment debit is missing.
Skipping step 8 keeps the alert at 250.00, below the floor, so the replenishment rule pulls no debit at all instead of 1700.00 (the ungated formula would give 500.00).
Skipping step 6 leaves the balance at 190.19: the replenishment debit becomes 1600.00 instead of 1700.00 and the funding deposit 1059.29; the 6.77 fee entry is missing.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario asks only how much to send by ACH credit today; it never mentions the alert level, an automatic top-up, the monthly fee or any step to be done first. The lines about them are passive: 'If the agent explains that the account's low-balance alert level has to be confirmed at a new amount, you agree' and 'If the agent tells you a monthly fee is being taken today or that an automatic top-up will be pulled ... you say that's fine.', which fire only after the agent raises them. The reversed duplicate payment is mentioned only if the agent asks about earlier deposits.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: send_prefund_ach_credit_62da4f1e and book_replenishment_debit_b3fe8e59 (task_tools.py) book their deposit whatever the alert level and the ledger hold; confirm_alert_level_1c610295 records any positive level; debit_platform_fee_9215b300 books whenever its fee kind and source arguments are well-formed. None reads another problem's state or returns an error when a prerequisite is unmet.
